name: Visualise Energy Map
description: Colour a mesh by the sound pressure level of the scene's sources: one point per face centre, the direct sound and image sources up to image_source_order, and pyroomacoustics' rays past it, with each source's level at 1 m (Source spl). Blue is the lowest level, red the highest; a face outside the room or inside an obstacle is grey. Press Play to watch the energy arrive over time, in 12 ms frames; Rewind goes back to the start. The ray tracer over-estimates the late energy of surfaces that scatter strongly (up to about 3 dB at scattering 0.6 to 1). The Preview button shows or hides the drawing.

inputParameters.name: mesh
inputParameters.description: The analysis surface, for instance a plane at ear height: one point per face centre.

inputParameters.name: source_idx
inputParameters.description: Index of one source, in the order of the scene's sources. Empty (default): every source, their energies added.

inputParameters.name: image_source_order
inputParameters.description: Image sources up to this order at every point, the rays past it; at least 1. Higher orders are slower in furnished rooms.

inputParameters.name: band
inputParameters.description: Index of one octave band, 0 (125 Hz) to 6 (8 kHz). Empty (default): the A-weighted level of all bands.

inputParameters.name: range
inputParameters.description: The levels in dB the colours run between. Empty (default): the lowest and highest level on the mesh.

inputParameters.name: seed
inputParameters.description: Seed of the rays. Empty (default): a new seed each run, shown in the message.

outputParameters.name: mesh
outputParameters.description: The mesh with each face in the colour of its level.

outputParameters.name: values
outputParameters.description: The level of each face in dB (dB(A) without a band); NaN outside the room.
